1be22c5d9d62: <span1>Simple media player that plays everything well.</span1> <span2>Video, audio, streams and web video, edited, exported and recorded, on your screen, on a TV or speaker, or across an AVB network, by yourself or with your favourite AI agent.</span2>
823609cc4ff6: Material 3 toolbars float over the picture and slide away as you watch, or stay docked, in light or dark, in your system's accent colour, picture in picture and full screen.
4c2329716938: Windows releases of plaa are signed by Scramble Tools LLC with <a1>Microsoft Azure Artifact Signing</a1>, and macOS releases with Scramble Tools' Developer ID, notarised by Apple.
adb4574276e8: Committers and reviewers: the members of the scrambletools GitHub organisation, who review every outside contribution before it is merged.
2105694538c0: Approvers: the owner of the scrambletools GitHub organisation, who alone can run the release workflow, which signs, and publish a release.
38c1931ed3c3: Video is decoded on the graphics card where it can be, up to 8K at 60 frames a second on a card that can, and drawn by plaa's own shader: BT.601, BT.709 and BT.2020 colours, 8 to 16 bits, HDR10 and HLG tone mapped for an ordinary screen, and phone videos turned upright. The picture keeps in step with the sound, by the output device's own clock.
cc3e703d5fa6: A sound file shows its cover, title, artist and album, with the spectrum of what you hear below them, as bars that rise with it and fall back slowly, or the file's waveform from start to end, the part played in the accent colour, which a click or a drag seeks along.
4ca6fd3d67d0: Or choose Prism from the visualiser menu: a scene in three dimensions that fills the window and moves with the music, a lace orb around a core that swells on each beat, ringed by glass shards rising with the spectrum, over a rippling grid of light.
3774e8c07ee7: The assistant and agents can put the picture or the sound, all of it or a part, through FFmpeg's filters: black and white, colour, contrast and warmth, a crop, sharpening, a vignette, a title over the picture, fades, less noise, a quieter or louder sound, or an even loudness. Describe the look or the sound you want, such as "make it black and white, with a little more contrast", and the assistant chooses the filters.
9dc8ca2429f1: Export (Ctrl+E) saves what plays, as edited, as H.264, HEVC or AV1 with AAC sound, at the file's own size or smaller. plaa encodes on the graphics card where it can (NVENC, AMF, Quick Sync, VAAPI or VideoToolbox) and on the processor otherwise, and the dialogue says which. HDR video keeps its colours in HEVC and AV1.
0ad5714bc5f5: Writing the edit to a new file, as the Export dialogue does
c78b110c847d: Media keys work, and what plays shows with its cover in the system's own controls: MPRIS on Linux, which playerctl drives too, the media flyout on Windows, and Now Playing on macOS. On macOS plaa has its own menu bar and a title bar in plaa's colours, and on Windows the title bar follows plaa's light or dark. On Linux, plaa's packages use the system's FFmpeg and sound server, PipeWire or PulseAudio.
75f4370aa86b: Settings (Ctrl+,) has seven tabs, six on Windows, which has no Network tab. Appearance chooses light or dark, the system's accent colour or one of plaa's, animations, and how the floating controls look and when they hide. Playback has hardware decoding, the sound output, resuming, folder playlists, the streams' quality, yt-dlp, and Make Default, which makes plaa the system's default app for video and sound files. Storage chooses the folders recordings and saved frames go to; Network, the AVB interface, Send what plays and plaa's name on the network; Language, plaa's language and the languages tracks are chosen by; Agents and Assistant, what the previous sections describe.
77aa7e8d1b39: The Export dialogue over Big Buck Bunny looking up at a butterfly on a tree: H.264, HEVC, AV1 or sound only, encoded on the graphics card, at 1080p as it is, 720p or 480p
3234eaecae83: plaa's Settings over a paused video, on the Appearance tab: Follow system, Light and Dark, the system accent colour switch and the colour swatches, and the floating controls' settings
1635d69a704b: Material Design 3, light or dark, and the accent colour from the system or one chosen
0be5de4dc5a1: Through agents and the assistant: FFmpeg's filters on the picture or sound, all of it or a part, such as black and white, colour, crop, sharpening, titles, fades, noise reduction, volume and loudness; checked before they run, and only filters that change each frame as it comes, none that touch files, devices or the network; played at once, undone with undo, and exported, a crop over the whole movie at its new size
